column5: HOUSE EDGE DISAGREES THREE WAYS. Client HiLoGame.tsx:347 defaults to 0.01 (1%) and computes (100/winChance)*(1-houseEdge); server game-settlement/index.ts:3918 sets HILO_DEFAULT_HOUSE_EDGE = 5.0 (5%). There is no _shared/hilo.ts, so settlement lives only in game-settlement. ★ UNITS RISK: the server constant is in PERCENT while the client expects a FRACTION, and both read the same gamingConfig.hilo_house_edge - if that key stores 5 meaning 5%, the client computes (1 - 5) = -4 and yields a NEGATIVE multiplier. Verify what the key actually stores. ★ FIGMA FRAME BUG: for the same stated odds (Higher-or-Same 30.77%, Lower-or-Same 76.92%) the Hi-Lo Start frame shows Higher 1.17x / Lower 4.29x while the Hi-Lo Loss frame shows Higher 3.22x / Lower 1.29x. Only Loss is arithmetically consistent (0.99/0.3077 = 3.22, 0.99/0.7692 = 1.29, a 1% edge). Start is INVERTED - it pays 4.29x on the 76.92%-likely outcome, which is house-negative if built literally. Also carries a "Practice mode off" toggle that Casey has asked to be removed
